{{Quote|I told you this was going to happen. We've wasted enough time with those losers.|Bric, speaking to El-Les about Domino Squad|<ref name="cc" />}}
'''Bric''' was a battle-worn [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] whom the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] hired to help train [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. For his assignment, Bric assumed the role of [[Drill sergeant/Legends|drill sergeant]] and, along with the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]], also received the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Master Chief/Legends|Master Chief]] as he trained [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]]. Bric personally conditioned the members of [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]], a unit that displayed disobedience. 

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], toward the end of Domino Squad's training, Bric was disgusted with the five cadets' inability to work together and wanted to reassign them to [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City's]] [[Clone military education complex|Military Complex]] maintenance crew, where rejected cadets were sent. After Domino Squad failed to pass its [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|final challenge]], the clones were given a second chance to retake the test, during which they came together and passed, an accomplishment that impressed the Master [[Chief/Legends|Chief]]. Bric and Domino Squad parted ways after its members became battle-ready [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], though Bric continued working on Kamino until at least circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This particular unit seems to have some trouble. What do you recommend?''"<br />"''Well, I'm no Jedi, so forgive my bluntness, but I say they fail. Send them down to maintenance with 99 and the other rejects.|Shaak Ti and Bric|<ref name="cc" />}}
Bric, a [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="card" /> was a battle-worn [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="republic" /> and a veteran of local wars.<ref name="H2H" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] hired the Siniteen<ref name="cc" /> as a [[Drill sergeant/Legends|drill sergeant]]<ref name="card" /> to train various [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]. In Kamino's [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], Bric was joined by another [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter, the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]]<ref name="El-Les">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_el-les.jpg|text=Clone Card: El-Les|nobackup=1}}</ref> [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]], and both received the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Master Chief/Legends|Master Chief]] as they conditioned the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]]. Bric personally trained the disobedient unit [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]], which consisted of<ref name="cc" /> [[Hevy/Legends|CT-782]], nicknamed "Hevy"; [[Echo/Legends|CT-21-0408]], nicknamed "Echo";<ref name="ep guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}}</ref> [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]],<ref name="Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref> nicknamed "Fives"; [[Droidbait/Legends|CT-00-2010]], nicknamed "Droidbait"; and [[Cutup/Legends|CT-4040]].<ref name="ep guide" />

[[File:BricBreaksUpEchoHevy-CC.png|thumb|left|240px|Bric breaks up Echo and Hevy.]]
Toward the end of Domino Squad's training<ref name="republic" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="CC date">{{TCWdates|301}}</ref> Bric and El-Les joined [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], who oversaw all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] training on Kamino, in the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Clone military education complex|Military Complex]] testing chamber.<ref name="cc" /> On a secure observation deck that overlooked the chamber,<ref name="republic" /> the trio watched Domino Squad practice for its final test&mdash;the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]], in which the cadets were pitted against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that were serving as [[Training droid/Legends|training droids]]. The cadets' primary objective was to secure a flag at the top of a large tower. During the squad's practice exam, Bric and the others noticed the cadets' inability to operate as a team, which caused them to fail their test. After their practice, the frustrated clones returned to their [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]]. When Domino Squad members Hevy and Echo started to [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fight]] as a result of their emotions, a timely arrived Bric angrily broke up the brawl and criticized their actions.<ref name="cc" />

The next [[Standard day/Legends|day]],<ref name="republic" /> Bric and El-Les rallied Domino Squad and other cadet units on a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] deck. Near the two bounty hunters stood the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] of the [[Rancor Battalion/Legends|Rancor Battalion]], led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]], who were there to oversee the cadets' final test&mdash;if the cadets passed, they would be considered battle-ready clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Bric followed El-Les and Colt as they prepared to watch [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]],<ref name="cc" /> a unit trained by El-Les that,<ref name="republic" /> according to Colt, had passed its practice test in "ARC trooper [[Time/Legends|time]]." On the observation deck, Bric and the others watched the unit as it engaged in the Citadel Challenge as a team. Domino Squad was up following the completion of Bravo Squad's test, and the group made its way into the testing grounds. As Bravo Squad's Citadel Challenge progressed without any setbacks from the team, Bric told El-Les to give the squad its next set of instructions for the exam, and the Arcona bounty hunter relayed the directives.<ref name="cc" />

During the next task, Droidbait was injured, and his squad mates left him behind. Noticing that they had abandoned a teammate, a disapproving Colt interrupted the cadets' progress by automatically failing them. After Domino Squad botched the Citadel Challenge, Bric and El-Les left the testing chamber and proceeded to the clone barracks, where El-Les informed Bric that he had requested that Shaak Ti grant Domino Squad a second chance to undergo the exam. The decision troubled Bric, as he had already made a request to reassign Domino Squad to the city's maintenance crew because of the cadets' continuing struggles.<ref name="cc" /> Later that night,<ref name="republic" /> Bric called for CT-4040, a cadet from Domino Squad whom Bric believed was the reason that the unit was failing, to a hangar bay. When the clone did not take him seriously, Bric shoved CT-4040 in an attempt to force the clone into aggression, calling him a "cutup." However, CT-4040 did not retaliate and instead thanked Bric for giving him a name. This incensed Bric, who promised that he would see Cutup's squad disqualified.<ref name="cc" />

[[File:BricCutup-CC.png|thumb|right|250px|Bric and Cutup]]
When it came time for Domino Squad's retaking of the Citadel Challenge, Bric joined El-Les and Ti on the testing chamber's observation deck. Prior to the test, Bric shadily removed the [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension cables]] from the cadets' [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belts]], an item that was needed for the Citadel Challenge. When Bric admitted to his actions, El-Les tried to stop the test, as he saw Bric's actions as unfair. However, despite the setback, Domino Squad successfully used the Citadel tower's [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster turrets]] to scale it and pass the exam. Impressed with the squad's ability to improvise, Ti told Bric that his aggressive actions had brought out the best in the cadets. After the test, the two bounty hunters congratulated Domino Squad on its success before watching their batch of clone troopers depart for the front lines.<ref name="cc" />

Later in the war, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Fugitive date">{{TCWdates|603}}</ref> Bric was still present in Tipoca City. Fives returned to Kamino in an attempt to find the reason for [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] trooper [[Tup/Legends|CT-5385's]] mental breakdown during a [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|battle]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]]. When Fives [[Escape from Tipoca City/Legends|fled]] from the city with the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347/Legends|AZI-3]] in order to distract the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]&mdash;whom he feared would [[Brain/Legends|brainwash]] him because he had discovered that they had inserted [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chips]] into the brains of all clone troopers&mdash;and returned to the city shortly thereafter, Bric was walking alongside El-Les and some clone cadets in a hallway. At the same time, AZI-3 tricked a clone trooper into following him so Fives could steal the trooper's [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Fugitive">{{TCW|Fugitive}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The sergeant is the army.|Bric|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BricSmirk-CC.png|thumb|left|250px|El-Les and Bric's feelings toward Domino Squad often clashed.]]
A Siniteen bounty hunter, Bric stood 1.9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="card" /> and weighed eighty-three [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="H2H" /> He had olive-[[Color/Legends|colored]] skin<ref name="cc" /> and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="republic" /> Bric himself was a stern, smart,<ref name="data">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02b058b7b012b213f15340268|text=Dataclip: Clone Cadets|na=video file}}</ref> and aggressive [[Sentience/Legends|being]].<ref name="cc" /> The battle-worn<ref name="republic" /> bounty hunter took a no-nonsense approach when it came to military training.<ref name="card" /> A bully, Bric used his aggression to bring out the best in his trainees.<ref name="H2H" />

Bric was openly critical of Domino Squad, as well as the malformed clone [[99/Legends|99]], who was part of Tipoca City's maintenance crew. Unlike fellow bounty hunter El-Les, who cared for Domino Squad,<ref name="cc" /> Bric did not tolerate failure.<ref name="data" /> Following Domino Squad's practice test, Shaak Ti called for 99's maintenance crew to clean up the testing ground, and Bric told Ti that 99 should also "drag away the mess called Domino Squad." When squad mates Hevy and Echo began to fight in the barracks, the Siniteen angrily broke up the brawl, claiming that they would stand a chance out on the battlefield if they took out their aggression on battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] instead of each other. Since the entire squad was present, the bounty hunter revealed that he had once had high hopes for them, yet their repetitive failures and lack of teamwork caused him to lose faith in their abilities. He personally believed that the non-combative "bad batcher" 99 had more sense than them.<ref name="cc" />

Following Domino Squad's failure to pass its final examination, the Siniteen told El-Les that he cared little for the floundering squad and was concerned only with the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|payment]] that he would receive from the Republic after Domino Squad's training. Bric physically assaulted Domino Squad cadet CT-4040 in an attempt to force some aggression out of him. When the clone failed to take Bric seriously, Bric called him "a real cutup" due to his sense of humor and inability to take anything as more than a joke. Before Domino Squad retook the Citadel Challenge, Bric took the cadets' ascension cables from their utility [[Belt/Legends|belts]] to further challenge them. El-Les denounced Bric's actions, but he replied that only the best could pass the test&mdash;if Domino Squad wanted to persevere, it would have to improvise. The clones succeeded by climbing the [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] of the Citadel building in the testing chamber. Bric was impressed with their efforts and called the cadets "creative little clones." [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master Shaak Ti claimed that Bric's actions brought out the best in Domino Squad.<ref name="cc" />

==Equipment==
The drill sergeant<ref name="card" /> sported green-yellow&ndash;colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]] during his time on Kamino. The armor's chest piece featured three vertical red lights located on the left side. Bric also carried a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] in a holster on his right leg.<ref name="cc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bric was first mentioned in [[StarWars.com]]'s "[[Hasbro]] Comic-Con Round-Up" article, which was published on [[July 29]], [[2010]].<ref name="hasbro">{{SWArchive|url=vault/collecting/hasbro_comiccon_2010_roundup/index.html|text=Hasbro Comic-Con Round-Up}}</ref> Hasbro also produced an action figure of Bric for its [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' toy line]] as part of an exclusive giveaway promotion.<ref name="hasbrotoy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=Galactic Battle Mat|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWEXBric.asp}}</ref> The character first appeared in "[[Clone Cadets]]," the first episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], which aired on [[September 17]], 2010. The episode's script originally described Bric as a [[Human/Legends|Human]], but his species was later changed to Siniteen. Bric was voiced by actor [[Larry Brandenburg]] in the episode.<ref name="ep guide" /> The character later appeared in a tie-in children's novel for "Clone Cadets," ''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]'', which was released on [[October 7]], 2010.<ref name="republic" /> Bric also made an appearance in "[[Fugitive]],"<ref name="Fugitive" /> the third episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]],<ref name="Fugitive ep guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/fugitive-episode-guide|text="Fugitive" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> which was released on [[March 7]], [[2014]].<ref name="TCW on Netflix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-lost-missions-now-on-netflix|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars &ndash; The Lost Missions Now on Netflix|nolive=1}}</ref>

===Non-canon biography===
Bric is featured in a [[Canon|non-canonical]] event in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head]]'' book, in which Bric is looking for someone to help him train clone troopers. During the process, the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] bounty hunter [[Castas/Legends|Castas]] applies for the job but underestimates Bric's strict requirements. In order to help train the clones, Castas has to defeat Bric in combat. Although both of them have [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], Bric decides to test the Klatooinian in head-to-head combat. Despite being undisciplined as a fighter, Castas complies with Bric's order and proceeds to attack Bric. The brawl is a lost cause for Castas, as he is unable to stop Bric. He is soon incapacitated and, as a result, fails the test.<ref name="H2H" />
